limitations: Local host envelopes bind commit labels and artifact hashes but contain no trusted CI provenance; producer workflow run identity is supplied separately.
Offline readback cannot re-observe the original live filesystem installation or processes.
Streaming samples cover the initial process only; restart checks cover recovery behavior, not a second streaming performance measurement.
VS performanceGate=false and JB sloStatus=not-evaluated: timings are measurements, not streaming SLO passes.
JB paintImmediately covers the visible region and long tasks cover sampled probe EDT tasks only; Markdown parse calls are uninstrumented.
Deterministic fixture content does not prove real-provider latency or fidelity.
Nine downloaded host artifacts exclude Remote-SSH evidence; this receipt does not verify that separate gate.
IDE host verification does not satisfy CLI CI or CLI Strict Sandbox release gates.
archivalNotes: No release binaries, screenshots, or full host logs are archived here.
All original envelope JSON bytes are retained and can be rehashed.
VS stream profiles and JB Workbench metrics retain their original captured UTF-8 bytes.

JB native raw metric text is exporter-redacted: sourceSha256 hashes the unredacted original, archivedSha256 hashes the retained text, normalizedDataSha256 hashes its parsed canonical object. Its runToken is a measurement UUID, redacted consistently with the original exporter.
VS needs_input records are filtered from the original CDP ledger. sourceSha256 binds the complete original ledger; archivedSha256 and normalizedDataSha256 bind the retained projection.

Offline replay checks retained measurements, schema projections, envelope digests, and artifact-record links. It does not rehash omitted image/log/binary bytes; use 96-matrix-verify-downloaded.mjs with the complete download for that.

Run node docs/research/ide/evidence/96-matrix-replay.mjs for compact replay. Redacted native run-token syntax and identity are excluded; all other native fields are checked by the original strict verifier.
